name: Open Brewery DB
tagline: Free open dataset and REST API of US and global breweries
description: Open Brewery DB is a free and open-source dataset and REST API providing public brewery data including names, locations, types, and contact details. Developers can list, search, and filter breweries for maps, directories, and food-and-drink apps without authentication. Note: the autocomplete endpoint is deprecated and scheduled for removal from v1 by the end of 2026; prefer the brewery search endpoint.

auth.details: No authentication required for public API access; no API key or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free and open; no paid plans published

rate_limits: 120 requests per minute (per IP); rate limit headers returned

example.response_snippet: [{"id":"b54b16e1-ac3b-4bff-a11f-f7ae9ddc27e0","name":"10 Barrel Brewing Co","brewery_type":"large","address_1":"1501 E St","city":"San Diego","state_province":"California","postal_code":"92101-6618","country":"United States","longitude":"-117.129593","latitude":"32.714813","phone":"6195782311","website_url":"http://10barrel.com","state":"California","street":"1501 E St"}]

use_cases: search breweries by city or state
look up a brewery by id
autocomplete brewery names for a typeahead
filter breweries by type (micro, brewpub, etc.)
build a map or directory of local breweries
